Class HighScoreManager

java.lang.Object
com.tetris.gameLogic.HighScoreManager
public class HighScoreManager extends Object
A utility class responsible for persisting the high score to the local file system.

This class uses binary file I/O to save and retrieve a single integer value, ensuring the player's best score is remembered even after the application closes. The file location is determined by GameConfig.HIGHSCORE_FILE.

  • Method Details

    • saveHighScore

      public static void saveHighScore(int score)
      Writes the given score to the high score file.

      This method overwrites the existing file. It uses DataOutputStream to write the raw integer bytes, meaning the resulting file is binary and not meant to be edited manually by the user.

      Parameters:
      score - The new high score to save.

    • loadHighScore

      public static int loadHighScore()
      Retrieves the stored high score from the file system.

      If the high score file does not exist or if a read error occurs, this method safely returns 0.

      Returns:
      The saved high score, or 0 if no data is found.
